request_text:
Gate P4-G1 was reviewed by Test Tech Lead (decision event 3, 2026-11-17T17:43:38+00:00) and changes were requested: Test decisions on the two open product questions. (1) GT-29 and GT-30, duplicate phone numbers in the Excel member load: follow PRD FR-032 and architecture ASM-016/RSK-006. Rows are loaded as they are and same-phone rows are flagged as shared; nothing is merged. Rewrite the merge tasks to load-and-flag, and keep US-052.AC2 (merge) as a story open question for product; this decision resolves the blocking finding. (2) GT-42, WhatsApp payment receipt messages: out of scope per PRD section 3 and A-005. Do not plan a task that sends receipt messages; keep the rest of the story, and record US-023.AC2/AC3 as a story open question for the Tech Lead. This decision resolves the blocking finding.

These inputs changed since your last run: architecture.md, gates/G3B.approved.json, pack:task-breakdown/system_prompt.md. Update your output to match them and change only what needs changing.

gaps: {"rule": "review", "severity": "blocking", "item_ids": ["GT-29-T01"], "message": "US-052.AC2 (two rows with the same phone load as one member) conflicts with ASM-016 and FR-032 (rows sharing a phone are loaded and flagged as separate members). The task AC and the test AC follow the story, but the architecture says otherwise. Get a decision from the Tech Lead on which rule applies, and what happens to the plan and expiry of combined rows, before building. Also define name matching for possible duplicate. Keep 14 h until then."}

{"rule": "review", "severity": "blocking", "item_ids": ["GT-30-T01"], "message": "The task description loads shared-phone rows as separate flagged members (ASM-016), but US-050.AC2 says rows with the same phone are combined into one member. The AC-GT-30-T01-3 and the QA task AC-GT-30-T04-1 refer to an 'agreed combine rule' that does not exist. Resolve the conflict with GT-29-T01 first, then restate the rule in the AC. The 16 h cap is at the limit and depends on the unknown Excel layout, so split off Excel parsing and plan mapping if the layout is still unknown."}

{"rule": "review", "severity": "blocking", "item_ids": ["GT-42-T02"], "message": "This task sends a payment confirmation message on WhatsApp, which the PRD and architecture list as out of scope. It also depends on a consent field that does not exist yet. Hold the task until the Tech Lead decides whether US-023.AC2 is an approved exception, and, if it is, which consent field and template to use. If it is not an exception, the story's open deferral mechanism should be used to defer AC2 and this task."}

{"rule": "review", "severity": "blocking", "item_ids": ["GT-58-T01"], "message": "Cannot be built as written: whether history is re-pointed to the kept member or read through a link is undecided, and this drives the data model and hours. Decide that (PRD FR-035 says history stays on the archived record) and reference the real rule, since PD-022 is not in the PRD. Then split into a DB/migration task and the BE task if re-pointing is chosen."}
verdict.summary: Deterministic checks passed (31 warnings) over 55 stories. Reviewed 46 flagged items in 35 stories: 4 blocking, 42 warnings for the Tech Lead. GT-11: Story is 3 points (about 18 h) but tasks total 25 h. Part of the overrun is T02 and T03 likely duplicating sign-up work owned by other stories (GT-19 for POST /signups, the Join screen). Confirm ownership and shrink T02 and T03 to the branch rules only, or re-point the story.; GT-12: Story is 2 points (about 12 h) but tasks total 32 h. T01 at 14 h (replace every hard-coded string across all screens) depends on the screens existing, which other stories build. Limit T01 to creating the catalogue, the lookup and the error-code mapping, and require later stories to use it. Or accept the larger size.; GT-13: Story is 3 points (about 18 h) but tasks total 28 h. T01 and T02 can only guard endpoints and screens that exist now, and blocked stories GT-14, GT-15 and GT-32 add the rest. Keep T01 and T02 to the role-check mechanism and the screens already in the contract. A Tech Lead should confirm the size.; GT-14: Story is 5 points (about 30 h) but tasks total 41 h. T03 (deactivated-account refusal in staff sign-in) overlaps GT-15-T01, which also refuses deactivated accounts in POST /auth/staff-sessions. Keep it in one story, drop the duplicate, and re-check the total.; GT-15: Story is 3 points (about 18 h) but tasks total 44 h. This includes a password-reset flow that is not in api-gym-api-v1 and whose delivery channel is undecided. Resolve the reset decision (an open question for the PRD), or move T02 and the reset parts of T03 and T04 to a separate story. Until then the 12 h reset estimate, at low confidence, is a placeholder.; GT-15-T02: Low confidence is justified. The reset delivery channel and the actor are undecided, and the endpoints are missing from api-gym-api-v1. Keep the task usable behind the delivery interface. Record the open question on the story, and have the Tech Lead confirm the contract addition and re-estimate when the channel is decided.; GT-20-T01: Low confidence is justified. The task needs an email field and a plan choice at sign-up that the contract and ent-member do not define (Q-012 is open). The WhatsApp answer (FR-042) is also not defined in the architecture. Do not build until the Tech Lead decides where email and the chosen plan are stored and whether email is mandatory. This task also depends on the GT-20-T02 migration and on GT-19-T02.; GT-22: Story is 3 points (about 18 h) but tasks total 29 h. T01 also serves GT-38 as shared work, and T04 duplicates some of GT-38's verification. Confirm the single date function is owned by one story and that the expiry convention (10 Dec versus the last valid day, PD-006) is settled, then re-check the sizing.; GT-23: Story is 3 points (about 18 h) but tasks total 34 h. T02 (webhook storage rules) overlaps the confirmation handler in GT-22-T02, and the UPI-and-card-only restriction has no confirmed mechanism. Limit T02 to the storage and log-redaction rules, add the dependency on GT-22-T02, and confirm the Razorpay restriction method before building.; GT-25-T01: Hours depend on open decisions: how the app finds the open order (the OpenAPI contract has no such operation) and when an unconfirmed order stops blocking a new one. The task is buildable. Before starting, have the Tech Lead choose a contract addition or reuse of the membership view, and a time limit. Note that PD-011 in the PRD is a dashboard definition, not a payment rule.
